verdict.rationale: Martin documents some multi-item actions of its own. Forwarding an email makes it add all the listed events to the calendar, and email triage automatically labels emails and takes follow-up actions. Users can also import their to-dos from Todoist in one step. However, there is no general documented bulk-operation capability, such as acting on many to-dos, notes, or messages at once from a single command. Missing for 10: general bulk edit/delete across item types, documented scale limits for batch actions, and hands-on corroboration of bulk behavior.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Got an email with events coming up? Forward it to Martin, and he'll add them all to your calendar.
Martin can automatically label your emails and take follow up actions on your behalf.
Optionally, you can import your to-dos from Todoist in the Martin web app -> Settings -> To-dos.
